responses.draft_cover_letter:
I am eager to join Tidewater Robotics in Southampton and contribute to your embedded‑software projects. While my résumé does not yet list direct experience with ARM Cortex‑M, FreeRTOS/Zephyr, or hardware bring‑up using oscilloscopes, I have a solid foundation in C/C++ development and a strong interest in low‑level firmware work.

My background includes hands‑on programming and debugging of microcontroller‑based systems, which has prepared me to quickly acquire the specific skills you require, such as SPI, I²C, and CAN communication protocols. I am comfortable using laboratory equipment and am motivated to master oscilloscope techniques during the onboarding process.

I look forward to discussing how my enthusiasm for embedded engineering and my proven ability to learn new technologies can add value to Tidewater Robotics.
